elements.text:
You've been talking to your crush on Snapchat and they're usually quick to respond. You see that they opened your message a couple of hours ago and did not respond. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I'm worried this has something to do with me, but realize this person has a lot of other things going on in their life.
I'm sad that my crush didn't respond quickly, but know that I won't feel sad forever.
I'm sad that my crush didn't message back immediately.
I feel happy with my ability to send fun messages.
